import pandas as pd

def main():
    # List all source file paths
    source_files = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_91/test_0.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_91/test_1.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_91/test_2.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_91/test_3.csv"
    ]

    # Initialize a list to hold the extracted attributes from all sources
    all_attributes = []

    # Process each source file
    for file_path in source_files:
        # Load the source CSV into a DataFrame
        df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

        # Extract the 'attributes' column, drop NaN values, and get unique values
        attributes = df['attributes'].dropna().unique()

        # Append these attributes to the list
        all_attributes.extend(attributes)

    # Get unique attributes across all sources
    unique_attributes = sorted(set(all_attributes))

    # Create the target DataFrame with the required schema
    target_df = pd.DataFrame({'attributes': unique_attributes})

    # Write the target DataFrame to the specified CSV file
    target_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_91/target_multisource_cot.csv", index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
